q1: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f1, (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f2 WHERE f1.drinker < f2.drinker AND f1.st = f2.st
q2: SELECT freq_a.drinker, freq_b.drinker FROM frequents AS freq_a JOIN frequents AS freq_b ON freq_a.times_a_week = freq_b.times_a_week WHERE freq_a.drinker > freq_b.drinker

explanation: Q1 compares aggregated sums of times_a_week per drinker, while Q2 compares individual times_a_week entries between drinkers. When two drinkers have the same total sum but no matching individual times, Q1 returns them but Q2 does not.
